log "AmneziaWG VPN: starting"
install -d /srv/awg
cat > /srv/awg/gryonixnexus-update.sh <<'EOF_AWGVPN_UPDATE'
#!/bin/bash
# Managed by gryonixNexus — AmneziaWG VPN (amnezia-wg-easy) update for the Server Dashboard.
set -euo pipefail
cd /srv/awg
docker compose -p awgvpn pull -q
docker compose -p awgvpn up -d
EOF_AWGVPN_UPDATE
chmod 750 /srv/awg/gryonixnexus-update.sh
cd /srv/awg
# First run only: generate the panel password on this server and hash
# it with the image's own wgpw tool (bcrypt); re-runs keep it.
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
  AWGVPN_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 12)"
  timeout 300 docker pull -q ghcr.io/deckersu/amnezia-wg-easy:14 >/dev/null || true
  # `wgpw` hashes the password with the image's own bcrypt. It MUST be
  # a one-shot that exits: when the entrypoint does not recognise the
  # sub-command it falls through to starting the panel instead — a
  # long-running server — and the whole installation hangs here with no
  # output (reported in the field, stuck at "AmneziaWG VPN: starting").
  # Hence: explicit entrypoint first, plain sub-command as a fallback,
  # and a hard timeout on both so this can never wedge the install.
  AWGVPN_HASH=""
  for AWGVPN_TRY in entrypoint command; do
    if [ "$AWGVPN_TRY" = entrypoint ]; then
      AWGVPN_OUT="$(timeout 60 docker run --rm --entrypoint wgpw ghcr.io/deckersu/amnezia-wg-easy:14 "$AWGVPN_PASSWORD" 2>/dev/null)" || AWGVPN_OUT=""
    else
      AWGVPN_OUT="$(timeout 60 docker run --rm ghcr.io/deckersu/amnezia-wg-easy:14 wgpw "$AWGVPN_PASSWORD" 2>/dev/null)" || AWGVPN_OUT=""
    fi
    # Accepts both shapes the tool has used: PASSWORD_HASH='<hash>'
    # and a bare hash line. Quotes are stripped rather than matched, so
    # no `$` of the bcrypt hash has to survive shell quoting here.
    AWGVPN_HASH="$(printf '%s' "$AWGVPN_OUT" | head -n1 | sed "s/^PASSWORD_HASH=//" | tr -d "'")"
    # Anything that is not a bcrypt hash is not an answer.
    case "$AWGVPN_HASH" in '$2'*) break ;; *) AWGVPN_HASH="" ;; esac
  done
  if [ -n "$AWGVPN_HASH" ]; then
    printf 'ADMIN_PASSWORD=%s\nPASSWORD_HASH=%s\n' "$AWGVPN_PASSWORD" "$AWGVPN_HASH" > .env
  else
    # No hash: the stock panel starts without a password. It binds
    # loopback only and nothing proxies it — clients are managed from
    # the unified VPN panel — so this is a degraded but working VPN,
    # which beats an installation that never finishes.
    log "AmneziaWG: could not hash a panel password (the image's wgpw tool did not answer) — its built-in panel stays open on localhost only. The VPN itself works; manage clients at vpn.<domain>."
    printf 'ADMIN_PASSWORD=%s\nPASSWORD_HASH=\n' "$AWGVPN_PASSWORD" > .env
  fi
fi
# docker compose interpolates $ inside .env values, so the bcrypt
# hash must carry $$ or it reaches the container mangled (the WARN
# "variable is not set" flood). Idempotent: runs of $ collapse to $$,
# an already escaped hash is left as is; also repairs pre-fix installs.
sed -i '/^PASSWORD_HASH=/s/\$\{1,\}/$$/g' .env
chmod 600 .env
docker compose -p awgvpn pull -q
docker compose -p awgvpn up -d
